text:
Hi, I’m Tobias Reyne, a full stack developer with 7 years of experience in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, and HTML/CSS.

I can help update your product page URL structure to remove the category path and set up reliable 301 redirects so existing pages continue to resolve cleanly. I’m careful with routing changes and redirect logic to avoid broken links and protect SEO.

One relevant project I’ve worked on was Embedded customer analytics, where I built usage dashboards embedded in a SaaS product so each customer account saw its own metrics. It was rolled out to 140 customer accounts and delivered 3 weeks early.

If you’d like, I can take a close look at the current URL patterns and outline the redirect approach before implementation.
